features.name: 8 Homeward
features.origin: Crater visible in the iconic “Earthrise” colour photograph, taken aboard Apollo 8 by W. A. Anders on December 24, 1968, symbolizes the safe return to Earth of Apollo 8. The crater was previously designated Ganskiy (Hansky) M.
features.reference: [483] - Apollo 8: The Thrilling Story of the First Mission to the Moon, by Jeffrey Kluger: Henry Holt and Company, 2017.
